role: XCTest suite pinning the Terms of Use / first-launch disclaimer: Apple DPLA 3.3.3 F(iii) route-guidance notice is present verbatim, precedes the closing sections, and TermsOfUseView.lastRevisedDate is not before 2026-10-05.
types: HealthDisclaimerTests: class — @MainActor XCTestCase over HealthDisclaimer and TermsOfUseView.lastRevisedDate

units.does: Asserts HealthDisclaimer.routeGuidanceNotice equals the exact Apple English sentence and that some HealthDisclaimer.sections body contains it (navigationSections appends routeGuidanceNoticeText, which always ends with the English notice).
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

flags.text: The assertion message claims the English notice is present 'whatever the app language', but the test runs only in the host's current LanguageManager.appBundle language; the non-English branch of routeGuidanceNoticeText (HealthDisclaimerView.swift:31 append path) is never exercised.

units.does: Asserts the first section body containing the route-guidance notice has index < sections.count - 2, i.e. it comes before the last two sections (end of riskSections and ageSection).
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass
XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

flags.text: Compares the production constant lastRevisedDate (TermsOfUseView.swift:7, 2026-10-05) against a hard-coded literal 2026-10-05 in the test; nothing ties the literal to when the notice text changed, so the test cannot detect a text change without a revision-date bump.
